text:
mira.l: kicking off staggered rollout v2024.12 -> prod. plan: canary 1% -> 8% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. change window closes 01:45 UTC. release notes: https://redwood.example/release/v2024.12 :sparkles:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout initiated (id: r-20241208-09). Canary at 1% -> auto-increase to 8% in ~7m unless manually paused.
dan.p: heads up: synthetic probe showing p99 tail on reranker at ~1776543250 against long queries. p95 ok but isolated p99 spikes to ~900ms. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/reranker
oscar.t: any corresponding increase in 5xxs or downstream queueing?
dan.p: 5xxs flat, but redis latency on a subset of keys jumps when the canary receives heavy long-query traffic. looks like kvcache miss amplification.
deploy-bot: Reached 8% at 1776543280. Autosafety engaged; holding per gate for 10m observation.
mira.l: quick ops poll: :thumbsup to continue global rollout, :thumbsdown to rollback canary to v2024.11, :hand to region-pin ap-northeast and continue elsewhere. 5m to vote.
oscar.t: :hand: pin ap-northeast to v2024.11, there's a big marketing crawl scheduled there.
dan.p: :thumbsdown: if redis p95 >50ms or p99 >700ms for 5m, favor rollback.
sre-bot: Noted incident-visibility: paging infra @infra-oncall and app-slo @slo-oncall. Attach traces from reranker canary.
mira.l: tally so far 1 hand (oscar.t), 1 down (dan.p). leaning safe: do regional pin for ap-northeast and keep hold at 8% globally for 20m.
oscar.t: executing pin now. command: ```redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-northeast --service reranker --from v2024.12 --to v2024.11 --reason "kvcache miss amplification + local marketing crawl"```
deploy-bot: Queued pin job j-30071. ETA ~35s.
ops-bot: ap-northeast pin completed at 1776543310. traffic for ap-northeast back at v2024.11.
mira.l: extending hold to 20m. ops: please watch redis latency, downstream queue depths, and token billing spikes. if any of the thresholds hit (redis p99 >700ms, errors >0.4%, or token cost spike >1.5x baseline) we rollback.
dan.p: starting short synthetic sweep against v2024.12 canary focusing long-context keys. will post results in 10m.
oscar.t: i'll tail the marketing job logs and confirm no overlap.
ops-bot: rolling collection of heap and redis traces started for canary instances.
mira.l: also add tag "partial-pin-apne" to this rollout and update the release notes with the pin rationale. no full rollback yet; keep this thread as single source-of-truth. :eyes:
